questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Read an event probability from a Venn diagram.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Add the two fully labelled disjoint regions inside the requested event.
provenance.year_basis: AS/Year12 scope: Add the two fully labelled disjoint regions inside the requested event.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find missing Venn probabilities using independence.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use independence to determine one unknown Venn region, then use total probability to determine the other.
provenance.year_basis: AS/Year12 scope: Use independence to determine one unknown Venn region, then use total probability to determine the other.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Find a conditional probability involving a complement.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Form a conditional probability with a complemented conditioning event; its denominator follows from the fully labelled B regions, so neither unknown from(b)is needed.
provenance.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 scope: Form a conditional probability with a complemented conditioning event; its denominator follows from the fully labelled B regions, so neither unknown from(b)is needed.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: State a binomial modelling condition.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Use nested binomial models for packets and boxes.

context.shared_stem_html: Original question information and preceding context. Only the selected unit is scored:

provenance.difficulty_basis: Calculate two packet-count probabilities, then reuse the unprinted lower-tail probability as the success parameter for a second binomial model over boxes.
provenance.year_basis: AS/Year12 scope: Calculate two packet-count probabilities, then reuse the unprinted lower-tail probability as the success parameter for a second binomial model over boxes.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Test a claimed proportion of prize packets.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Set a lower-tail binomial hypothesis test using the stated population claim, calculate a suitable tail probability and conclude in context at the specified significance level.
provenance.year_basis: AS/Year12 scope: Set a lower-tail binomial hypothesis test using the stated population claim, calculate a suitable tail probability and conclude in context at the specified significance level.

questions.preview_text: Assess seasonal bias in a rainfall estimate.

questions.subject: Mathematics

provenance.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 scope: Find an upper-tail probability from the fully specified normal height distribution.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Test a normal mean and calculate a two-sided p-value.

provenance.difficulty_basis: Use the sample-mean normal distribution with the known standard deviation for a two-sided test, conclude in context and double the derived one-tail probability for its p-value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.preview_text: Derive a relation in a conditional-probability game model.

provenance.year_basis: Additional A-level/Year13 scope: Derive proportional probability relations for the spinner outcomes and combine them with normalisation to determine the complete discrete distribution.
